title: Motif's project workflow records
description: The Motif store keeps project workflow records and frozen Report bindings in the project's paired database. Parsimony judgments remain durable FieldWorks project data, while analysis artifacts are disposable files.
helpPage:
# Motif store

The Motif store keeps a project's Proposals, jobs, Assessments, Reports, Receipts, and other workflow records. Parsimony judgments belong with the FieldWorks project; the files used to analyse a grammar can be rebuilt.
